scientific_integrity.hypotheses: Odd distinct primes 3<=p<q and n=2p^2q; exactly two distinct omitted proper divisors.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Only the exponent shape 2p^2q. Does not cover all three-prime 2-near-perfect integers. Independent validation has not been performed. Prior public examples are credited; novelty is exhaustive classification, subject to bibliographic risk.
scientific_integrity.proof: Uniform surplus inequality for p>=7 and mixed divisor comparisons for p=3,5 reduce to seven explicit cases, exactly four accepted.
